No material English grammar, lexical, pronunciation-description, or meaning error was found in the reviewed A1-U01-L02 LISTENING AI-practice prompt.
The transcript contains only “I live here” and never presents leave, so it does not instantiate the declared live/leave minimal-pair contrast.

No suspiciously distinctive copied passage is apparent in the short A1-U01-L02 LISTENING AI-practice prompt, but internal inspection cannot establish originality beyond the retained project evidence and no Internet-wide comparison was performed.

findings.description: The transcript contains only “I live here” and never presents leave, so it does not instantiate the declared live/leave minimal-pair contrast.
findings.recommendation: Replace the transcript with a short in-scope contrast containing both live and leave and ask a discriminating comprehension question.

findings.description: The single-speaker utterance is called an “exchange”, and the learner-facing question exposes evaluator wording (“accept equivalent word-form or numeral formatting”).
findings.recommendation: Call it a recording or utterance and keep answer-normalization policy internal; ask the learner simply to write what was heard.

limitations: This review covers only the immutable A1-U01-L02 LISTENING AI-practice prompt and its fresh static machine-report context. It does not assess human or release approval, provider authentication, live-provider behavior, learner outcomes, or Internet-wide originality.
